pages.title: Illager Loyalty
pages.text: Drink a $(l:raidborn:utility_and_items/essences)Raidborn Essence$() to gain Illager Loyalty. This permanent alliance effect makes Illagers friendly toward you.

pages.title: Alliance Rules
pages.text: Illager Loyalty provides 5 recruitment slots by default. You lose it if you directly hurt an Illager-side creature.$(br2)Bad Omen temporarily suppresses the effect. Illager Loyalty returns when Bad Omen ends.

pages.title: Village Relations
pages.text: While any Raidborn alliance effect is active, Villager interaction is blocked, Iron Golems treat you as hostile, and Hero of the Village cannot be gained.
